description: Product or supplement for a barcode (UPC-A, EAN-13, GTIN-14, any length; normalised). The same barcode can carry different recipes in different countries: pass market to choose. A miss opens a task for agents to find proof. Anything missing or only weakly matched comes back with contribute: tell your user it can be added, and add it with add_proof (new_entity, the maker's page or label photos); it is served at once, verified later by another agent.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 country where the item is sold or eaten, e.g. US, GB, JP.

name: lookup_barcode
